plugin.name: Custom My Account Page for WooCommerce
plugin.description: Turns the WooCommerce My Account page into a branded customer portal: reorder/rename/disable default endpoints, add custom endpoints, collapsible groups and external links, restrict items by user role, upload a per-member avatar, and override menu colours. Admin runs on the shared Wbcom settings shell; no REST, no custom tables.

ajax.purpose: Endpoint builder: render the HTML for a newly added endpoint / group / link row. Target validated against allowlist [endpoint, group, link].
Return the avatar upload/reset form markup for the change-photo popup on My Account.

form_post_handlers.purpose: Handle the member avatar upload (media_handle_upload), validate MIME [jpeg/png/gif/webp] + 2MB cap, store attachment id in user meta wb-wcmp-avatar, then redirect.
Delete the custom avatar attachment + user meta and fall back to Gravatar.

admin_pages.title: WB Plugins
admin_pages.source: admin/class-woo-custom-my-account-page-admin.php::wcmp_add_plugin_menu_page (only when no other Wbcom plugin already registered the shared top-level menu and Wbcom_Settings_Page exists)

admin_pages.title: Woo My Account
admin_pages.source: admin/class-woo-custom-my-account-page-admin.php::boot_settings_page via Wbcom_Settings_Page::boot (shared Wbcom Pattern A shell; prefix wcmp)

settings_tabs.title: Overview
settings_tabs.renders: render_overview_tab — portal status (account-page mode, menu entry counts, custom/role-restricted counts, default endpoint, update state) + support links. Read-only.

settings_tabs.title: Endpoints
settings_tabs.renders: admin/partials/wcmp-endpoints-settings.php — drag-and-drop builder (nestable) for reorder/rename/disable/add of endpoints, groups, links; per-item icon, css class, user-role allowlist.

settings_tabs.title: General
settings_tabs.renders: render_general_tab — avatar toggle, menu layout (sidebar|tab), sidebar position (left|right), default endpoint.

settings_tabs.title: Style
settings_tabs.renders: render_style_tab — six colour pickers (menu item, menu hover, logout text/hover, logout bg/hover).

settings.note: Only menu_item_color + menu_item_hover_color are bridged to frontend CSS custom properties in wcmp_get_custom_css; the four logout_* keys are persisted and rendered in the Style tab but are not emitted as inline overrides in the current public CSS bridge.

keys: endpoints[key] => {active, label, slug, class, icon, type (endpoint|group|link), usr_roles[], + content|open|url,target_blank per type}
settings.note: Endpoint content is trust-modelled like post_content: unfiltered_html users keep raw markup, others go through wp_kses_post.

options.written: Settings API + update_option_wcmp_endpoints_settings hook mirrors slugs to WC core options

options.purpose: Flat list of uploaded avatar attachment ids (for a media-library filter scope).
LEGACY pre-1.x endpoint store; migrated in-place by wcmp_update_old_items on init.
One-time backup of wcmp_endpoint before migration (version-suffixed).
WC core endpoint slug — kept in sync when a default endpoint is renamed.
Preset free EDD license key (auto-seeded once on admin_init).
Deleted on uninstall; flagged in contract-audit baseline as written-never-read (suppressed, warning).
Legacy request-state flag; deleted on uninstall, no longer written (save_is_my_account deprecated 1.6.4). Baseline-suppressed.

transients.purpose: Set when endpoint settings save; wcmp_maybe_flush_rewrite_rules flushes on next init then deletes.

user_meta.purpose: The member's uploaded avatar; overrides Gravatar site-wide when custom_avatar is enabled.

shortcodes.purpose: Place the full portal on any page — delegates to [woocommerce_my_account] so the navigation takeover applies.
Render WooCommerce's default dashboard template, for embedding inside a custom endpoint's content.

blocks.name: wcmp/my-account
blocks.purpose: Drop the full My Account portal on any page including block themes.

wc_endpoints.mechanism: add_rewrite_endpoint(slug, WC()->query->get_endpoints_mask()) + injects slug into WC()->query->query_vars for each custom endpoint; rewrite flush deferred via the wcmp_flush_rewrite_rules transient.
wc_endpoints.note: No custom DB tables — custom endpoints are WordPress rewrite endpoints layered on the WC My Account query.

capabilities.notes: Not a capability — logged-in gate on the member-facing avatar flows.

services.purpose: Bootstraps loader, i18n, admin + public hooks. Single run() from plugins_loaded (after WooCommerce active check).
Standard boilerplate hook registry (add_action/add_filter collectors + run()).
Singleton. Owns the frontend portal: menu takeover, endpoint content, settings-data assembly + defaults, endpoint registration, role visibility, legacy migration, shortcodes, block registration.
Settings screen (Overview/Endpoints/General/Style/FAQ), sanitizers, endpoint-builder AJAX, WC slug sync, rewrite-flush scheduling, FA-to-Dashicon admin preview map.
Frontend assets (conditional), get_avatar filter, avatar upload/reset/form, menu-item classes, style token bridge.
Shared Wbcom Pattern A admin shell — highest bundled version across active Wbcom plugins wins.

frontend_hooks.purpose: Render the custom menu; core woocommerce_account_navigation is removed in Functions::init.
Output a custom endpoint's stored content (kses then do_shortcode).
Swap in the member's uploaded avatar. Uses a static re-entrancy guard; does NOT strip other get_avatar filters.
Account-page detection, endpoint title, default-endpoint redirect (role-aware), avatar upload/reset.
Conditional asset load — only on account page / portal shortcode / block (wcmp_should_load_assets, filterable via wcmp_load_public_assets).
Menu assembly, endpoint rewrite registration, block registration, legacy migration.

admin_hooks.callback: Admin::boot_settings_page(1) — Wbcom_Settings_Page::boot + nav-group filter + tab-content action
Admin::enqueue_styles / enqueue_scripts (screen-gated to the settings page)
wcmp_activation_redirect_settings — lands on Endpoints builder after activation

extension_seams.purpose: Return true to suppress the custom avatar for this request (default: mirrors the custom_avatar setting). Primary seam for coexisting with other avatar sources.
Force portal assets to load on a surface wcmp_should_load_assets does not auto-detect.
Override the resolved default endpoint at redirect time.
Amend the option shape for a new builder item.
Template arg / class hooks for the frontend menu.
Amend builder-row template args in admin.
Override the dashboard template used by default_dashboard_content.

bundled_libraries.name: Wbcom Settings shell
bundled_libraries.purpose: Shared Pattern A admin shell + assets (settings.css/js, RTL).

bundled_libraries.name: Scoped icon font
bundled_libraries.purpose: Custom 'WCMP Icons' font scoped to .wcmp-myaccount-template so it never clashes with a theme's own Font Awesome.

bundled_libraries.name: Select2
bundled_libraries.purpose: Role multiselect in the endpoint builder (local, not CDN).

bundled_libraries.name: Lucide
bundled_libraries.purpose: Icons in the shared settings shell.

third_party_integrations.purpose: Host — My Account page, endpoints, account menu, HPOS compat declared.

third_party_integrations.plugin: Other get_avatar sources (BuddyPress, Simple Local Avatars, etc.)
third_party_integrations.purpose: 1.6.5 fix: the get_avatar filter no longer calls remove_all_filters('get_avatar'); a static re-entrancy guard replaces it so other avatar plugins keep working after the first avatar renders.

third_party_integrations.plugin: Themes (Storefront, BuddyX, Reign, BuddyBoss, block themes)
third_party_integrations.purpose: Frontend colours follow the active theme via CSS-custom-property token bridge; Style pickers override only when changed.

third_party_integrations.plugin: Form plugins (e.g. Formidable) in endpoint content
third_party_integrations.purpose: Endpoint content is kses-sanitized then shortcode-expanded so form controls survive.

data_lifecycle.uninstall: uninstall.php deletes wcmp_general_settings, wcmp_endpoints_settings, wcmp_style_settings, wcmp_endpoint_order, wcmp_is_my_account, wcmp-users-avatar-ids, the three license options, the wcmp_flush_rewrite_rules transient, then flush_rewrite_rules(). NOTE: does not delete wcmp_endpoint (legacy) or the wcmp_endpoint_backup_pre_* backup, and does not remove wb-wcmp-avatar user meta or uploaded avatar attachments.

security.avatar_upload: MIME allowlist [image/jpeg,png,gif,webp] via wp_check_filetype_and_ext, 2MB size cap, logged-in gate, wp_handle_upload nonce, media_handle_upload. PRG redirect after handling.
security.ajax_gate: wcmp_add_field_ajax: nonce ajax_nonce + manage_woocommerce + target allowlist. wcmp_print_avatar_form_ajax: is_ajax + is_user_logged_in.
security.endpoint_content: kses_post for non-unfiltered_html users, raw for unfiltered_html — same trust model as post_content.
security.notes: No custom tables, no REST surface — attack surface is the two AJAX actions, two avatar POST flows, and the Settings API screens.

known_contract_baseline: See .contract-audit-baseline.json: eight suppressions (wcmp_endpoint_order / wcmp_is_my_account written-never-read; wcmp_endpoint dual-key; wcmp_settings_nav_groups / wcmp_settings_tab_content consumed-never-fired — these are fired by the bundled Wbcom_Settings_Page shell, not this plugin's own code, so the static audit cannot see the producer; ajax-action-no-handler:wcmp_reset_avatar — actually a template_redirect POST form, not admin-ajax; ajax-handler-unreferenced:wcmp_add_field — referenced via JS localize action_add; dom-action-no-handler:delete). All carry TODO 'justify or fix' reasons and should be resolved before the next release.
